content: Since we seek to train a general-purpose student language model, we elect to reuse the teacher model's original training objective to optimize the student model, i.e., masked language modeling and next sentence prediction, before any fine-tuning. In the former task, words in context are randomly masked, and the language model needs to predict those words given the masked context. In the latter task, given a pair of sentences, the language model predicts whether the pair is consistent.
